commits.body:

Follow the original JDK boxed hash and equality, byte reversal, unsigned comparison and CharSequence decoding. Resolve maximally specific interface defaults and preserve the JVM order of null, bounds and component checks for a single reference-array store. Qualify offset-sensitive UTF-16 matching, including the selected JDK’s negative-offset check before a null prefix.

The changed selection passed all 59 Rust binaries and six Python suites, including the regenerated conformance register. The new conversion boundary test and the three-way JVM, interpreter and native value tests passed.
